0022600116.text: The LA Clippers (1-1, second in the Pacific and one game back, seventh in the West) visit the 2-0 Oklahoma City Thunder (first in the Northwest, second in the West) for their third game of the season, coming off a loss and with a 0-1 road record. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Thunder are missing Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Clippers lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 128-110 in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026.
